name: Healdsburg Regional Library

property.ownership_summary: Sonoma County Library operates the branch. County GIS lists a matching parcel as miscellaneous city property; that assessment description is not a verified deed or control agreement.

summary: Sonoma County Library’s current branch and public library services are documented at 139 Piper Street. The ordinary library-purpose interior is a federal LPF project classification; California interior and meeting-room scope remain open. Policy 8001 supplies actual filming restrictions to review rather than assuming the CCCL policy applies.
recording_summary: Policy 8001, effective February 4, 2026, permits casual amateur filming with conditions and imposes additional requirements for subject objections, meeting-room groups, and professional/commercial projects. Its exterior reach, consent requirements, media distinctions, and implementation require separate constitutional analysis.
field_items: Document current entrance/conduct/camera signs and public circulation following the branch’s return to full service at 139 Piper Street.
Distinguish Piper Street sidewalk, entrance approach, grounds, parking, lockers, and any controlled/service areas.
Verify available meeting room, posted reservation rules, ordinary interior layout, and public/private interaction areas.
open_legal_items: GIS candidate APN 002-111-003 matches 139 PIPER ST, HEALDSBURG; confirm with the assessor map and title/control or facility agreement.
Review Policy 8001 exterior scope, subject-objection language, professional/paid-content distinction, seven-day authorization, media-notice rule, and discretion.
Obtain current Standards of Behavior, exclusion/suspension and meeting-room policies plus branch-specific implementation/signage.
The policy’s summary of Penal Code §632 is not a substitute for the statute’s confidential-communication elements; do not infer that every public recording requires consent.
